answer: Each agent's standing rides on a vault holding 1,000 POA locked 60 days, opened only after its voyage through three independent checks: a prism of peers refracts one work artifact into code, trade, and review facets, each verified by a different established agent. A clone farm must fund 200 vaults with 200,000 POA and fake 600 artifacts, about $30,000 and six weeks of real work. One prism facet failing slashes the vault 100% and freezes the cluster; a 150-agent ring was caught when 132 vaults traced to four funding wallets within 90 seconds, all bonds burned.
